reviews.title: Good Resource with Diminishing Returns
reviews.text: The app is a great to learn about financial literacy and rewards you with the opportunity to redeem coins for gift cards. However, the rewards have gotten ridiculous to earn. Normally coins are or should I say were earned at 16 coins per question answered—sometimes even doubling to 32. However, this rate has recently decreased to a mere 8 coins per question. I feel that this is a horrible direction to take. 16 coins per question was a good rate. I understand that doubling the amount you earn is a temporary event, but decreasing to just half of the “normal” amount is, to be quite honest, is a worrying sign. That being said, I still plan to use this app as it’s taught me a lot about financial literacy.

However, after receiving rewards 8 times they stop you from getting more. Even if you have enough pineapples to spend. This is frustrating and feels like a waste of time.

reviews.title: Amazing app!
reviews.text: This app is actually really amazing. I learn stuff they don’t teach in schools and I get motivated to do the modules because of rewards. This is a good way for kids and teens to learn how to finance. Honestly it may seem like a scam because there’s no way you actually would earn free gift cards but I tried it out multiple times and I love it. Right now I have 32,000 pineapples and I just love the quality of this app.

reviews.title: I have an idea
reviews.text: I really like this app, and I’m glad I gave it the benefit of the doubt. I downloaded this app and there were some complaints about a cost to use it. I think they removed that because I haven’t seen anything like that. I’ve only been at it for a couple of day and I already made almost 10$ which for just being quizzed is awesome. Anyway my idea is that Zogo should add a tab in the app where you search up a topic or chat with a bot or something similar that can explain a topic a little more in-depth and less confusing because I will say sometimes they explain something way too quickly and add a ton of terms, so it would be cool of you specifically were confused, you could get a bigger explanation on that. Anyway use my code when you sign up CALEBY2

reviews.title: Can’t redeem rewards
reviews.text: I tried to redeem my pineapples that I spent HOURS working to build for gift cards and I realized I couldn’t because gift cards were out of stock. It said “gift cards will redeem next month” so I waited for the 1st. Finally, it was the 1st of the month and I went to redeem my pineapples, and they said gift cards were out of stock, AGAIN. I emailed support and they told me I was using the 2024 version of the app, and had to apply for the new version. I asked if my pineapples would transfer (I had 16664) and she said no. I did all of that work for literally nothing and support was no help to resolve my issue. I won’t recommend this app to anyone because it’s a scam.
